title: XRP November 6 spot stabilization, derivatives positioning, attributed exchange wallets, order-book depth and ETF-vintage disagreement

research_window.note: The automation run-start time is recorded for chronology. Web-rendered sources did not expose exact request-completion times or original HTTP headers; no synchronized source cutoff is asserted.

append_only.purpose: Add a fresh Kraken ticker observation and reconcile new order-book, XRPL attributed-wallet, exchange-balance and ETF-vintage evidence without overwriting prior snapshots or averaging incompatible fund/venue universes.

source_capture_policy.reason: Sources were inspected through rendered web/API extracts. Original response bytes, headers, exchange sequence numbers and per-source retrieval timestamps were not available. Provider update times and ledger-read times are preserved only where the publisher exposed them.

limitations: The public ticker response did not expose a provider event timestamp or sequence identifier.
This is one venue's top-of-book and rolling 24-hour summary, not a consolidated executable market.
The ticker open field is the current UTC-day open, not a rolling 24-hour open.
The rendered JSON extract is not a byte-complete HTTP receipt.
Open-interest and funding aggregates are based on overlapping exchange feeds and are not independent exchange observations.
Liquidations are a lower bound because exchanges publish only part of real-time liquidations.
Long/short ratio is account-count based, not notional exposure.
USD-notional open interest changes with mark price as well as contract positions.
Displayed 15-minute delay is publisher-stated; exact underlying venue event times were not exposed.
The displayed depth snapshot has no exact event or retrieval timestamp.
The page simultaneously reports a four-exchange depth snapshot and 0/5 exchanges in the live-book status; the current live ladder was unavailable.
The order book is for XRP perpetual futures, not spot.
Resting orders can be cancelled; the publisher's pulled-wall spoof flag is heuristic, not proof of intent.
The snapshot cannot be treated as executable depth or durable support/resistance.

source_registry.balance_method: Daily rippled account_info reads against the latest validated ledger; wallet attribution uses XRPSCAN public labels.
limitations: The 22.28B XRP figure is a broad total of publicly attributed XRPL exchange wallets, including cold storage; it is not a tradable-float or order-book-reserve estimate.
Wallet attribution depends on XRPSCAN public labels and is not a verified beneficial-ownership record.
Same-wallet balance changes cannot distinguish customer withdrawals from internal transfers to wallets not yet labeled.
The dataset excludes exchange wallets outside the tracked 24-exchange universe and has documented coverage gaps.
Coinbase cbXRP reserve XRP is counted in exchange wallets and also in the publisher's DeFi allocation view, so those views overlap.
The page stores daily per-exchange totals, not per-wallet history.
The flow universe includes six spot products plus the BITW multi-asset index sleeve.
Flows are day-over-day holdings changes, not direct AP cash creation/redemption records.
GXRP flows are withheld after a prior issuer-page capture gap.
XRPR exposure is partly indirect through another XRP ETP; direct-only holdings do not capture its full exposure.
BITW holdings can change through multi-asset index rebalancing.
The latest November 5 row is provisional and can be rewritten during next-morning settlement.
The page reports flows for five funds but does not publish fund AUM or holdings for XRP.
Cumulative flow shares describe the distribution of reported net inflow, not current fund size or XRP holdings.
The underlying issuer-flow series overlaps other aggregators and is not an independent AP cash ledger.
The page's zero latest-session flow must be kept distinct from missing or pending data at other providers.
November 4 is partial at three of four funds; Franklin Templeton XRPZ had not published in the displayed capture.
November 5 had no issuer files in the displayed capture.
GXRP is not collected daily because its issuer page challenges automated readers; no access-control workaround was attempted.
XRPR is excluded because direct-only holdings do not represent indirect ETP exposure.
The publisher's holdings-change method can include fees, staking rewards and cash payouts, not only investor creations/redemptions.

The displayed November 4 net-flow figure is zero, while the page explains that incomplete sessions are blank rather than zero; per-fund completeness must be checked before treating a zero as a final all-fund total.
The snapshot predates later issuer-file and aggregator updates.
Underlying issuer holdings are shared with other aggregators and do not constitute an independent AP cash ledger.
The page's methodology says multi-asset index funds are excluded, but its ten-holder list includes NCIQ, which it identifies as a crypto index ETF.
The page describes the universe as ten spot XRP funds in some places and nine spot funds in another; the count is internally inconsistent.
The displayed top-three sponsor holdings are not the complete ten-fund register in the free view.

The Evernorth section still cites a pre-close June 30 balance and says no post-close balance is reported; this is stale against the October 30 SEC filing reporting approximately 473M XRP held as of October 9.
The tracker reports twelve products but its stated category counts (six spot, four derivative, one index) sum to eleven.
The tracker and its companion ETF-flows page show different AUM and daily-volume snapshots for the same stated date.
The page was not readable in the direct rendered-page capture; figures are retained only as search-result observations.

market_snapshot.capture_semantics: Asynchronous provider observations. No single synchronized consolidated XRP price, book or flow cutoff is asserted.

kraken_spot.interpretation: The last trade is slightly above Kraken's current UTC-day open but materially below its rolling 24-hour VWAP and high. This is a small venue-specific intraday recovery inside a much weaker 24-hour range, not evidence of a trend reversal.

limitations: Seven-exchange OI, five-exchange liquidations and five-exchange account ratios have different venue coverage.
The liquidation total is a lower bound.
The long/short ratio is based on account counts, not notional exposure.

coinfuty_perpetual_orderbook.snapshot_venue_scope: Publisher describes five futures venues: Binance, Bybit, OKX, Bitget and Gate; snapshot summary states four exchanges reported.
coinfuty_perpetual_orderbook.interpretation: The rendered snapshot shows a bid-side resting-liquidity skew, but the exact event time is absent and the page reported 0/5 live exchanges. It is a futures book, not spot depth, and is quarantined from model features.

xrp_insights_exchange_wallets.interpretation: The same-wallet decrease is a decline in balances of a tracked XRPL wallet set, not proof of customer withdrawals or a reduction in immediately sellable exchange float. The broad total includes cold custody, wrapped-token backing reserves and insurance/charity balances.

xrp_insights.fund_universe: Six US spot XRP products plus BITW multi-asset index sleeve.
xrp_insights.method: Daily issuer-reported holdings delta, not direct AP cash creation/redemption.
caveats: GXRP daily flow withheld after capture gap.
XRPR includes indirect exposure through another ETP; direct-only holdings are incomplete.
BITW is a multi-asset index sleeve and can move through rebalancing.
Some historical daily rows are reconstructed between issuer-file anchors.
Cumulative inflow share is not current holdings/AUM share.
Underlying issuer data overlaps other aggregators.
GXRP and XRPR excluded from daily flow totals for different coverage/structure reasons.
Holdings changes can include fees, rewards and cash payouts.
The page says incomplete days are blank rather than zero; the displayed zero needs per-fund completeness confirmation.
This is an earlier page vintage than later issuer-file observations.

shared_underlying_data_groups: TradRadar and Coinfuty both consume overlapping exchange derivatives venue data; they are distinct aggregators, not independent economic markets.

XRP Insights, Alpha Finance, CryptoKeyhole, Maketo, CorpStacking and TheXRPInvestor overlap sponsor/issuer holdings and public issuer disclosures; publisher outputs are not independent AP cash ledgers.
source_independence.rule: Preserve each provider's date, product universe, methodology and status. Do not average unlike OI, depth, exchange-wallet or ETF-flow figures.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: XRP shows a small Kraken UTC-day recovery while remaining materially below the rolling 24-hour VWAP and high; the recovery may be noise inside a broader drawdown.
supporting_evidence: Kraken last $1.21525 is 0.79% above its UTC-day open $1.20567.
Kraken last is 3.20% below its 24-hour VWAP.
TradRadar mark is $1.2203 with a 24-hour change of -6.71%.
disconfirming_or_missing: Provider event times are not synchronized.
UTC-day open and rolling 24-hour return are different windows.
No multi-session return distribution or out-of-sample model is evaluated.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The tracked XRPL wallet set has lower same-wallet balances over seven and thirty days.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights reports -301.5M XRP over seven days and -226.9M XRP over thirty days for the same tracked wallet set.
disconfirming_or_missing: The publisher explicitly says same-wallet changes cannot distinguish customer withdrawals from internal transfers to unlabeled wallets.
Cold custody and omnibus balances are included.
Wallet labels and coverage gaps remain.
Newly tracked wallets can create large naive total changes.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The 22.28B XRP attributed-wallet total overstates immediately tradable exchange supply.
supporting_evidence: 486.9M XRP is identified as non-customer or wrapped-token/insurance reserves.
Coinbase cbXRP backing is counted in both the exchange and DeFi allocation views.
disconfirming_or_missing: Some hot and deposit wallets may hold customer balances available for trading.
The public labels do not identify beneficial ownership or order-book availability.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Recent ETF flow evidence does not support a single unambiguous institutional-demand reading.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights reports -259,701 XRP over three settled days through Nov 4.
Alpha Finance reports +$78.9M over thirty sessions and +$4.8M over its last seven sessions.
CryptoKeyhole's Nov 3 complete-day result is -3,339 XRP, while Nov 4 is partial.
CorpStacking and TheXRPInvestor expose internal scope/count inconsistencies.
disconfirming_or_missing: Different dates, fund universes, direct/indirect holdings, index sleeves and calculation methods explain much of the apparent disagreement.
None of the aggregators is a direct AP cash creation/redemption ledger.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Coinfuty's rendered futures book snapshot displays more bid than ask depth within two percent.
supporting_evidence: The page reports $80.45M bids versus $72.51M asks within ±2%, approximately 53% bids.
disconfirming_or_missing: The snapshot event time is absent.
The page reports 0/5 live exchanges when rendered.
The snapshot covers futures, not spot.
Resting orders can be cancelled and are not executable depth.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The latest TradRadar snapshot remains consistent with a leveraged-long unwind.
supporting_evidence: Seven-exchange OI is down 5.77% over 24 hours.
At least $14.90M liquidations are reported, $14.45M from longs.
Long accounts are 80.1% of the five-venue account sample.
disconfirming_or_missing: Positive weighted funding of +0.0053% per eight hours remains.
Account counts are not notional exposure.
Liquidations are a lower bound and OI is USD-notional.

reasons: No byte-complete raw source payloads or SHA-256 source receipts were captured in this web-rendered research run.
Exact per-source retrieval timestamps and independent timestamp anchors are absent.
Kraken spot, TradRadar perpetuals and Coinfuty order-book snapshots are not synchronized.
Coinfuty's displayed live-book status was 0/5 exchanges; its numerical depth snapshot has no exact event time.
XRP Insights attributed-wallet balances are not tradable-float measures and same-wallet changes do not identify customer withdrawals.
ETF aggregators use different fund universes, product structures, dates and holdings-delta methodologies; direct AP cash records are unavailable.
CorpStacking and TheXRPInvestor contain internal product-count or page-metric inconsistencies that remain unresolved.
No evaluator-attested out-of-sample predictive lift, calibration, drift stability or shadow outcomes are supplied by these observations.

next_actions: Capture byte-complete Kraken ticker and depth HTTP responses with headers, local UTC receipt times, sequence identifiers where available and SHA-256 receipts.
Capture synchronized spot order books from Coinbase, Kraken, Bitstamp, Bitfinex, Gemini, OKX and Binance; keep futures order books separate.
Obtain raw XRP Insights exchange-wallet JSON and per-wallet histories; reconcile XRPSCAN labels, newly tracked wallets, cold custody and wrapped-token reserves.
Obtain each ETF sponsor's original holdings file, share count, XRP-per-share factor, NAV/net assets and publication timestamp; reconcile with AP cash creations/redemptions where publicly disclosed.
Resolve CorpStacking's NCIQ/index inclusion and 9-versus-10 fund count before using its 1.415B XRP headline.
Resolve TheXRPInvestor's 12-product versus 11-category count and $1.45B versus $1.57B AUM page disagreement.
Keep all observations in research-only quarantine until source receipts, point-in-time availability, source independence and evaluator gates pass.
Do not issue a directional XRP forecast from this snapshot.
